# The committed side of GPU rental is repricing up toward spot. | Compute Credit Index Research · LinkedIn · 2026-08-02T00:00:00+00:00

**Compute Credit Index Research**.

---

The committed side of GPU rental is repricing up toward spot.

On our published panel, the 1-year committed discount on Neocloud H100 narrowed from 14.8% to 9.0% over July.

Term ladders are flattening.

-and effective Aug 1 Azure's posted H200 reservation rates repriced: +2.9% on 1Y, +13.2% on 3Y.
